title: Salsa Updates the Beargrease Fat Bike
content:
Now in its fourth generation, the 27.5-wheeled Beargrease race bike just got a major overhaul from Salsa. This wholly redesigned chassis is longer, lower, and slacker for stable handling in all kinds of winter conditions…

Salsa Beargrease Quick Hits

  • Bare Bones: Beargrease Carbon frameset $1,999
  • Entry Tier: Beargrease Aluminum Eagle 70 complete $1,999
  • Top of the Line: Beargrease Carbon GX AXS complete $5,999
  • Five sizes (XS–XL)
  • Slacker head tube angle (65.6º) provides more control when descending steep, slippery terrain
  • Steeper seat tube angle (77º degrees) provides better power transfer from the saddle for traction on loose snow.
  • Longer rear center (446 mm) for added stability in snow
  • Improved standover for easier dismounts in deep snow
  • Supports up to 100 mm travel suspension fork for more playful riding

Since its introduction as the first carbon fat-tire bike, Beargrease has inspired people to rethink what fat-tire bikes can do. The fourth-generation Beargrease features geo tweaks for improved stability, flotation over snow, and cargo and accessory configurations. It’s for riders who don’t let adverse conditions or terrain slow them down: they embrace it. If their budget allows, the carbon chassis offers lightweight, lofty riding, or a more approachable aluminum model is available for riders who prefer 27.5 wheels over 26″ and want a no-frills expedition bike.

Geometry

The Beargrease received a slacker head tube angle (65.6º), a steeper seat tube angle (77º degrees), and a longer rear center (446 mm) for added stability in snow across all sizes.

Beargrease Chassis Updates

  • Carbon fiber and 6061-T6 aluminum frame options
  • New Bearpaw carbon and aluminum forks
  • Clearance for up to 27.5 x 4.5” or 26 x 4.8” tires
  • SRAM UDH compatible
  • Cargo and accessory mounts for any adventure:
  • Top tube bag mounts
  • Direct-mount frame bag mounts under top tube on Carbon
  • Two to three bottle mounts depending on size
  • Bottle/accessory mount under downtube
  • Two sets of Three-Pack mounts on fork
  • Rear Rack compatible with use of Salsa
  • Rack-Lock Seatpost Clamp
  • Downtube fender mount

Build Options

There’s a carbon frameset only for $1,999, the aluminum complete comes in at the same, the top end is the Carbon GX AXS complete $5,999, with a Carbon Eagle 90 at $4,299 and Carbon Eagle 70 at $3,299.
